stories.title: Solar Orbiter tracks origin of mysterious magnetic switchbacks
stories.summary: ESA's Solar Orbiter passed through a large S-shaped fold in the solar wind's magnetic field and measured the charged oxygen and carbon particles inside it. Their composition showed the plasma came from hot magnetic loops on the Sun, released when open and closed field lines reconnected. Waves and turbulence then appear to shape the fold as it travels outward, helping scientists understand how charged particles follow magnetic field lines and improving space weather forecasts.
